faqs.question: What is included in the ₹2 Lac Complete Builder Marketing Package?
faqs.answer: This package provides a comprehensive 3-month growth engine for builders and developers. It includes full Meta & Google ad management, a high-converting static project landing page, AI promotional videos, social reels, WhatsApp marketing automation, cold calling support, lead verification, lead qualification, and continuous campaign optimization with weekly reporting.

faqs.question: Does the ₹2 Lac fee include advertising budget or is it separate?
faqs.answer: The ₹2 Lac fee covers our full agency management, creative production, video development, landing page building, lead qualification team, and strategy for all 3 months. Ad spend (paid directly to Meta and Google) is separate and determined based on your target unit sales, inventory ticket size, and project locality. We help you set an optimal ad budget with zero wastage.

faqs.question: How does the Lead Verification and Qualification support work?
faqs.answer: We ensure your sales team never wastes time on junk or fake inquiries. Our dedicated qualification team calls and WhatsApp-verifies every incoming inquiry to confirm the buyer's budget, preferred unit configuration (e.g., 2 BHK, 3 BHK, Penthouse), location interest, and buying timeframe before handing them over or booking a site visit.

faqs.question: How quickly will our project website and campaigns go live?
faqs.answer: We execute rapidly. Your custom project landing page, ad creatives, and campaign setup will be fully configured and launched within 5 to 7 business days from onboarding and receiving your project collateral.

faqs.question: What types of real estate projects is this package best suited for?
faqs.answer: This package is specifically engineered for residential apartment launches, luxury villa developments, commercial retail/office spaces, and plotted townships seeking predictable, high-volume buyer inquiries and booked site visits.

faqs.question: Do we get complete ownership of the landing page, videos, and leads?
faqs.answer: Yes, 100%. All landing pages, domain configurations, AI promotional videos, ad creative designs, and prospective buyer databases belong exclusively to your firm.

faqs.question: How do we monitor performance and communicate with your team?
faqs.answer: You receive a dedicated Growth Account Manager. You get live lead alerts on WhatsApp/Email, weekly analytical reports tracking Cost Per Lead (CPL) and site visits, and scheduled bi-weekly review calls.

faqs.question: How do I get started with the ₹2 Lac Builder Package?
faqs.answer: You can click 'Select Plan & Get Started' to initiate onboarding online, message us on WhatsApp, or call our team directly at +91 9096090701. We will schedule a kickoff session within 24 hours.
